pr.title: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

intent.summary: Fix hono issue #5060: parseBody() and validator() matched Content-Type media types case-sensitively, so valid mixed-case values (Application/JSON, Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded) were skipped and handlers got {} / unvalidated data. Matching must be case-insensitive for the media-type part only; parameters (multipart boundary) stay intact. Change: lowercase media type in parseBody, /i on validator regexes, normalize media type in bufferToFormData, and route parseBody form parsing through arrayBuffer()+bufferToFormData with bodyCache.formData caching.
